definitions.explanation: Refined technical skill or artistry, especially in creative or artistic endeavors. Emphasizes the sophistication and polish of the technique rather than raw ability.

notes:
{技巧|ぎこう} refers to refined, polished technique — the kind of skill that comes from dedicated practice and artistic sensibility. It is often used in the context of music, art, literature, and other creative fields.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {技巧|ぎこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{凝|こ}らす→凝らす：08224_korasu⟧: to apply elaborate technique
- {技巧|ぎこう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: technical, technically skilled
- {技巧|ぎこう}{派|は}: the technical school (art/music movement emphasizing technique)
- ⟦{超絶|ちょうぜつ}→超絶：21692_chouzetsu⟧{技巧|ぎこう}: virtuoso technique
- {技巧|ぎこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to become overly focused on technique (at the expense of substance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: technique, technology (broader; includes practical and industrial skills)
- ⟦{技能|ぎのう}→技能：12801_ginou⟧: skill, proficiency (practical ability, often vocational)
- ⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧: skill level, ability (focuses on someone's demonstrated ability)
